findings.detail: The draft states the asked price of 104 without naming the quote date or source; the mispricing read leans on it.
findings.title: The 104 anchor is asserted, not shown

findings.detail: None of the five advisors compared the earnings yield to the stated risk-free rate, so the fair call is unanchored.
findings.title: No test against the risk-free alternative

summary: The draft's hold is defensible but rests on an unsourced price anchor and skips the risk-free comparison.
